en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Iran–Czech Republic treaty provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling on dividends where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Iran–Czech Republic treaty provides a general 5 per cent source-State ceiling on interest where the recipient is the beneficial owner, with residence-State-only taxation for qualifying credit sales, bank loans, government or central-bank cases, government-owned or controlled financial institutions and qualifying government-guaranteed financing. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Iran–Czech Republic treaty provides an 8 per cent source-State ceiling on royalties where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
